# Script introduction

A fourth external review (29 October 2026) asked for three robustness checks of the paper's main results:

1. **A flexible climate model.** The climate models of `s20` are additive and linear in six predictors, which may disadvantage climate. Here a generalised additive model with a smooth term for each predictor and a smooth interaction of temperature and aridity predicts the same held-out realms and subfamilies as the linear climate model and lineage, on identical folds. Every model is also fitted with species-specific evidence only, because types presumed from relatives could favour lineage.
2. **Shared climates with species-specific evidence only.** The standardised comparisons of `s18` (Cape and southern Australia against the Mediterranean Basin) and `s24` (southern Africa and Australia against every other region) repeated with the species whose type was recorded for the species itself.
3. **Dry seasons, genus by genus.** The association of obligate mutualism with dry months (`s19`):
   - left out one genus at a time;
   - estimated with every mixed genus weighted equally;
   - tested in phylogenetic logistic regressions on both grafted trees;
   - and repeated with a water-balance measure, the months in which precipitation falls below the potential evapotranspiration of the month (Hargreaves equation, as in `s01`).

A full run takes about 20 min.

```{r define_helpers}
# Binomial deviance and AUC (as in s20)
binary_deviance <- function(y, q) {
  q <- pmin(pmax(q, 1e-9), 1 - 1e-9)
  -2 * sum(y * log(q) + (1 - y) * log(1 - q))
}
auc <- function(y, q) {
  if (length(unique(y)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  r <- rank(signif(q, 8))
  n1 <- sum(y == 1)
  n0 <- sum(y == 0)
  (sum(r[y == 1]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}

# Evidence basis of each species unit (first row of the parent table)
read_basis <- function() {
  fread(file.path(dir_data_raw, "butterfly_ant_interactions", "species_table.csv"),
        colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))[, .(basis = interaction_type_basis[1]),
                                                by = pool_key]
}

# Shared strata and standardised shares (as in s24), for any table of pixels with `region` and
# stratum `s`, and species with `region`, `s`, `genus`, `type`
shared_strata <- function(area, sp_n, pr) {
  occ <- area[region %in% pr & pixels >= min_pixels]
  ok <- merge(occ, sp_n[region %in% pr], by = c("region", "s"))[n >= min_species_stratum]
  s_ok <- ok[, .N, by = s][N == 2]$s
  a <- area[region %in% pr & s %in% s_ok]
  a[, share := pixels / sum(pixels), by = region]
  a[, .(w = mean(share)), by = s]
}
standardised <- function(sp, w, pr, gw = NULL) {
  d <- sp[region %in% pr & s %in% w$s]
  d[, g := if (is.null(gw)) 1 else gw[genus]]
  d[is.na(g), g := 0]
  cnt <- d[, .(ob = sum(g * (type %in% c("m", "p"))), tot = sum(g)), by = .(region, s)]
  keep <- cnt[tot > 0, .N, by = s][N == 2]$s
  cnt <- merge(cnt[s %in% keep], w[s %in% keep], by = "s")
  cnt[, w := w / sum(w), by = region]
  cnt[, .(obligate = sum(w * ob / tot), strata = .N), by = region]
}
pair_contrast <- function(sp, area, pr) {
  sp_n <- sp[, .(n = uniqueN(pool_key)), by = .(region, s)]
  w <- shared_strata(area, sp_n, pr)
  if (!nrow(w)) return(NULL)
  obs <- standardised(sp, w, pr)
  if (nrow(obs) < 2) return(NULL)
  genera <- unique(sp[region %in% pr & s %in% w$s]$genus)
  bt <- vapply(seq_len(n_boot), function(b) {
    gw <- setNames(tabulate(sample.int(length(genera), replace = TRUE), length(genera)), genera)
    o <- standardised(sp, w, pr, gw)
    if (nrow(o) < 2) NA_real_ else o[region == pr[1]]$obligate - o[region == pr[2]]$obligate
  }, numeric(1))
  data.table(pair = paste(pr, collapse = " vs "), strata = obs$strata[1],
             obligate_1 = obs[region == pr[1]]$obligate, obligate_2 = obs[region == pr[2]]$obligate,
             difference = obs[region == pr[1]]$obligate - obs[region == pr[2]]$obligate,
             difference_low = quantile(bt, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
             difference_high = quantile(bt, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Save a figure with ragg
save_figure <- function(plot, name, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png)
}
theme_figure <- function(base_size = 9) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 0.5),
          plot.title.position = "plot", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
          legend.position = "bottom", plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
}
```

# 1. A flexible climate model, and species-specific evidence

For each contrast, evidence set and scheme (held-out realms; held-out subfamilies), every held-out unit is predicted by: the linear climate model of `s20` (logistic regression); the flexible climate model (binomial GAM with `s(x, k = 4)` for each of the six predictors and `ti(temperature, aridity, k = 4)`, smoothing estimated by REML in each fold); and lineage (random intercepts of subfamily and genus, variances from the fit to all species of the contrast; a species of an unseen genus or subfamily gets the average prediction over the random effects it does not know; not for held-out subfamilies, whose lineages are unknown by design). Pooled deviance explained relative to the training share, and AUC, with 95% intervals from resampling genera.

*Inputs:* s05/species_regions.csv; raw/butterfly_ant_interactions/species_table.csv
*Outputs:* flexible_climate.csv

```{r flexible_climate}
sp <- fread(file.path(dir_s05, "species_regions.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
sp <- merge(sp[interaction_type %in% types & !is.na(region) & subfamily != ""], read_basis(),
            by = "pool_key", all.x = TRUE)
sp <- sp[complete.cases(sp[, climate_vars, with = FALSE])]

flex_rhs <- paste(c(paste0("s(", climate_vars, ", k = 4)"), "ti(bio01, log_aridity, k = 4)"),
                  collapse = " + ")
lineage <- "s(subfamily, bs = 're') + s(genus, bs = 're')"

set.seed(20261029)
pred <- rbindlist(lapply(c("associated", "obligate", "parasite"), function(ct) {
  rbindlist(lapply(c("all", "specific"), function(ev) {
    d <- copy(sp[interaction_type %in% contrasts[[ct]]$rows])
    if (ev == "specific") d <- d[basis %in% contrasts[[ct]]$specific]
    d[, y := as.integer(interaction_type %in% contrasts[[ct]]$success)]
    for (v in climate_vars) set(d, j = v, value = as.numeric(scale(d[[v]])))
    d[, `:=`(genus = factor(genus), subfamily = factor(subfamily))]
    schemes <- list(`held-out realm` = d$region, `held-out subfamily` = as.character(d$subfamily))
    rbindlist(lapply(names(schemes), function(s) rbindlist(lapply(unique(schemes[[s]]), function(u) {
      test <- schemes[[s]] == u
      if (sum(test) < 5 || length(unique(d$y[!test])) < 2) return(NULL)
      train <- d[!test]
      X <- model.matrix(as.formula(paste("~", paste(climate_vars, collapse = " + "))), data = d)
      fit <- suppressWarnings(glm.fit(X[!test, , drop = FALSE], train$y, family = binomial()))
      b <- fit$coefficients
      b[is.na(b)] <- 0
      q_lin <- as.numeric(plogis(X[test, , drop = FALSE] %*% b))
      m_flex <- tryCatch(gam(as.formula(paste("y ~", flex_rhs)), data = train, family = binomial,
                             method = "REML"), error = function(e) NULL)
      q_flex <- if (is.null(m_flex)) rep(NA_real_, sum(test)) else
        as.numeric(predict(m_flex, newdata = d[test], type = "response"))
      out <- d[test, .(genus, y)]
      out[, `:=`(q0 = mean(train$y), climate = q_lin, `climate (flexible)` = q_flex)]
      if (s == "held-out realm") {
        # Random-effect variances estimated on the training species only (REML in each fold)
        m_lin <- gam(as.formula(paste("y ~", lineage)), data = train, family = binomial,
                     method = "REML", drop.unused.levels = FALSE)
        out[, lineage := predict_lineage(m_lin, train, d[test])]
      }
      out[, `:=`(contrast = ct, evidence = ev, scheme = s, unit = u)]
    }), fill = TRUE)), fill = TRUE)
  }), fill = TRUE)
}), fill = TRUE)

pl <- melt(pred, id.vars = c("genus", "y", "q0", "contrast", "evidence", "scheme", "unit"),
           measure.vars = c("climate", "climate (flexible)", "lineage"), variable.name = "model",
           value.name = "q")[is.finite(q)]
metric <- function(y, q, q0) c(d2 = 1 - binary_deviance(y, q) / binary_deviance(y, q0),
                               auc = auc(y, q))
res <- pl[, {
  m <- metric(y, q, q0)
  idx <- split(seq_len(.N), genus)
  bt <- t(replicate(n_boot, {
    i <- unlist(idx[sample.int(length(idx), replace = TRUE)], use.names = FALSE)
    metric(y[i], q[i], q0[i])
  }))
  list(species = .N, d2 = m[["d2"]], d2_low = quantile(bt[, "d2"], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
       d2_high = quantile(bt[, "d2"], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE), auc = m[["auc"]],
       auc_low = quantile(bt[, "auc"], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
       auc_high = quantile(bt[, "auc"], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
}, by = .(contrast, evidence, scheme, model)]
write_table(res, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "flexible_climate.csv"))
print(res, digits = 2)
```

# 2. Shared climates with species-specific evidence

*Inputs:* s13/ pixel_strata.rds, record_pixels.rds, taxa.csv; raw/butterfly_ant_interactions/species_table.csv
*Outputs:* shared_climates_specific.csv

```{r shared_specific}
pix <- readRDS(file.path(dir_s13, "pixel_strata.rds"))
rec <- readRDS(file.path(dir_s13, "record_pixels.rds"))
rec[, pool_key := as.character(pool_key)]
taxa <- fread(file.path(dir_s13, "taxa.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
taxa <- merge(taxa[classified == TRUE], read_basis(), by = "pool_key", all.x = TRUE)

run_design <- function(px, region_col, pairs, evidence) {
  p <- px[!is.na(get(region_col)), .(cell, region = as.character(get(region_col)), s = stratum)]
  area <- p[, .(pixels = .N), by = .(region, s)]
  t <- if (evidence == "specific") taxa[basis %in% specific_basis] else taxa
  sp <- unique(merge(rec[cell %in% p$cell], p, by = "cell")[, .(region, s, pool_key)])
  sp <- merge(sp, t[, .(pool_key, genus, type = interaction_type)], by = "pool_key")
  rbindlist(lapply(pairs, function(pr) pair_contrast(sp, area, pr)))
}
set.seed(20261029)
med_pairs <- list(c("Cape", "Mediterranean Basin"), c("Southern Australia", "Mediterranean Basin"))
all_pairs <- unlist(lapply(southern_regions, function(a)
  lapply(setdiff(region_levels, southern_regions), function(b) c(a, b))), recursive = FALSE)
res <- rbindlist(lapply(c("all", "specific"), function(ev) rbind(
  run_design(pix, "med_region", med_pairs, ev)[, design := "Mediterranean-climate regions"],
  run_design(pix, "region", all_pairs, ev)[, design := "All land"])[, evidence := ev]))
write_table(res, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "shared_climates_specific.csv"))
print(dcast(res, design + pair ~ evidence, value.var = c("difference", "difference_low")),
      digits = 2)
```

# 3. Dry seasons, genus by genus

## Water-balance months

For every pixel holding records of an associated species, the number of months in which precipitation is below the month's Hargreaves potential evapotranspiration; the median over each species' record pixels.

*Inputs:* raw/worldclim_2.1/ monthly prec, tmin, tmax; s19/species_drought.csv; s02/species_records.rds
*Outputs:* species_drought_balance.csv

```{r water_balance}
read_monthly <- function(variable) {
  zip <- file.path(dir_data_raw, "worldclim_2.1", paste0("wc2.1_10m_", variable, ".zip"))
  files <- sort(grep("\\.tif$", unzip(zip, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE))
  rast(file.path("/vsizip", zip, files))
}
sp <- fread(file.path(dir_s19, "species_drought.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
x <- readRDS(file.path(dir_s02, "species_records.rds"))
x[, pool_key := as.character(pool_key)]
prec <- read_monthly("prec")
x <- x[pool_key %in% sp$pool_key]
x[, cell := cellFromXY(prec, cbind(decimalLongitude, decimalLatitude))]
px <- unique(x[!is.na(cell), .(pool_key, cell)])
cells <- unique(px$cell)
P <- as.matrix(prec[cells])
TN <- as.matrix(read_monthly("tmin")[cells])
TX <- as.matrix(read_monthly("tmax")[cells])
lat <- yFromCell(prec, cells)
days <- c(31, 28.25, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31)
ra <- extraterrestrial_radiation(lat)
pet <- pmax(0.0023 * ra * ((TN + TX) / 2 + 17.8) * sqrt(pmax(TX - TN, 0)), 0) *
  matrix(days, length(cells), 12, byrow = TRUE)
deficit <- data.table(cell = cells, deficit_months = rowSums(P < pet))
px <- merge(px, deficit, by = "cell")
med <- px[, .(deficit_months = median(deficit_months, na.rm = TRUE)), by = pool_key]
sp <- merge(sp, med, by = "pool_key")
write_table(sp, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "species_drought_balance.csv"))
print(sp[, .(species = .N, dry_months = median(dry_months), deficit_months = median(deficit_months)),
         by = interaction_type])
cat("Correlation of dry months and water-deficit months:",
    round(cor(sp$dry_months, sp$deficit_months, use = "complete.obs"), 2), "\n")
```

```{r clear_water_balance, include=FALSE}
invisible(gc())
```

## Effects, leave-one-genus-out, genus-balanced and phylogenetic

*Inputs:* s28/species_drought_balance.csv; s04/grafted_trees.rds
*Outputs:* drought_robustness.csv, drought_logo.csv, drought_genus_balanced.csv

```{r drought_robustness}
sp <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "species_drought_balance.csv"),
            colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
lineage <- "s(subfamily, bs = 're') + s(genus, bs = 're')"
prep <- function(ct, v) {
  d <- copy(sp[interaction_type %in% contrasts[[ct]]$rows & is.finite(get(v))])
  d[, `:=`(y = as.integer(interaction_type %in% contrasts[[ct]]$success),
           z = as.numeric(scale(get(v))), region = factor(region), genus = factor(genus),
           subfamily = factor(subfamily))]
  d
}
effect <- function(d) {
  m <- gam(as.formula(paste("y ~ region + z +", lineage)), data = d, family = binomial,
           method = "REML")
  cf <- summary(m)$p.table["z", ]
  c(estimate = cf[[1]], se = cf[[2]], p = cf[[4]])
}
within_slope <- function(d) {
  mixed <- d[, .(both = uniqueN(y) == 2), by = genus][both == TRUE]$genus
  dm <- droplevels(d[genus %in% mixed])
  fit <- suppressWarnings(glm.fit(cbind(dm$z, model.matrix(~ genus - 1, dm)), dm$y,
                                  family = binomial()))
  fit$coefficients[1]
}

# --- Main effects with both measures, all contrasts ---
props <- c(dry_months = "Dry months (P < 2T)", deficit_months = "Water-deficit months (P < PET)")
res <- rbindlist(lapply(c("obligate", "mutualist", "parasite"), function(ct)
  rbindlist(lapply(names(props), function(v) {
    e <- effect(prep(ct, v))
    data.table(contrast = ct, property = v, analysis = "Given region and lineage",
               estimate = e[["estimate"]], se = e[["se"]], p = e[["p"]])
  }))))

# --- Phylogenetic logistic regressions with region, on both grafted trees ---
trees <- readRDS(file.path(dir_s04, "grafted_trees.rds"))
phylo <- rbindlist(lapply(names(trees), function(study) rbindlist(lapply(
  c("obligate", "mutualist"), function(ct) rbindlist(lapply(names(props), function(v) {
    d <- as.data.frame(prep(ct, v)[species %in% trees[[study]]$tip.label])
    rownames(d) <- d$species
    tr <- keep.tip(trees[[study]], d$species)
    m <- tryCatch(phyloglm(y ~ z + region, data = d, phy = tr, method = "logistic_MPLE",
                           btol = phyloglm_btol), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(m)) return(NULL)
    cf <- summary(m)$coefficients["z", ]
    data.table(contrast = ct, property = v, analysis = paste("Phylogenetic,", study),
               estimate = cf[[1]], se = cf[[2]], p = cf[[4]])
  }))))))
res <- rbind(res, phylo)
write_table(res, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "drought_robustness.csv"))
print(res, digits = 3)

# --- Leave one genus out: every genus with obligate species, for the effect given region and
# lineage; every mixed genus, for the within-genus slope ---
d <- prep("mutualist", "dry_months")
ob_genera <- d[, .(ob = sum(y)), by = genus][ob > 0]$genus
logo <- rbindlist(lapply(as.character(ob_genera), function(g) {
  e <- tryCatch(effect(droplevels(d[genus != g])), error = function(e) c(estimate = NA, se = NA, p = NA))
  data.table(left_out = g, analysis = "Given region and lineage", estimate = e[["estimate"]],
             p = e[["p"]])
}))
mixed <- d[, .(both = uniqueN(y) == 2), by = genus][both == TRUE]$genus
logo <- rbind(logo, rbindlist(lapply(as.character(mixed), function(g)
  data.table(left_out = g, analysis = "Within mixed genera",
             estimate = within_slope(droplevels(d[genus != g])), p = NA_real_))))
write_table(logo, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "drought_logo.csv"))
print(logo[, .(fits = .N, min = min(estimate, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
               max_p = max(p, na.rm = TRUE)), by = analysis], digits = 3)

# --- Genus-balanced: in every mixed genus, the mean standardised dry months of its obligate
# mutualists minus that of its facultative species; every genus weighted equally ---
gb <- d[genus %in% mixed, .(difference = mean(z[y == 1]) - mean(z[y == 0]),
                            mutualists = sum(y), facultative = sum(1 - y)), by = genus]
set.seed(20261029)
bt <- replicate(10000, mean(sample(gb$difference, replace = TRUE)))
genus_balanced <- data.table(genera = nrow(gb), positive = sum(gb$difference > 0),
                             mean_difference = mean(gb$difference),
                             low = quantile(bt, 0.025), high = quantile(bt, 0.975),
                             sign_test_p = binom.test(sum(gb$difference > 0), nrow(gb))$p.value,
                             wilcoxon_p = wilcox.test(gb$difference)$p.value)
write_table(gb, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "drought_genera.csv"))
write_table(genus_balanced, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "drought_genus_balanced.csv"))
print(gb[order(-difference)], digits = 2)
print(genus_balanced, digits = 3)
```

# Figure

(a) Pooled held-out deviance explained of the linear and flexible climate models and of lineage, for held-out realms and subfamilies, with all classified species and with species-specific evidence only (95% intervals from resampling genera). (b) Standardised difference in obligate share within shared climates, with all classified species and with species-specific evidence only. (c) Effect of dry months and of water-deficit months on obligate mutualism given region and lineage, and in phylogenetic logistic regressions; grey: range when each genus with obligate species is left out. (d) Mean standardised dry months of the obligate mutualists minus the facultative species of each mixed genus.

*Inputs:* s28/ flexible_climate.csv, shared_climates_specific.csv, drought_robustness.csv, drought_logo.csv, drought_genera.csv
*Outputs:* plot_robustness.png

```{r plot_robustness}
fc <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "flexible_climate.csv"))
sc <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "shared_climates_specific.csv"))
dr <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "drought_robustness.csv"))
logo <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "drought_logo.csv"))
gb <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "drought_genera.csv"))

fc[, `:=`(contrast = factor(sapply(contrasts, `[[`, "label")[contrast],
                            sapply(contrasts, `[[`, "label")),
          evidence = factor(c(all = "All classified", specific = "Species-specific")[evidence]),
          model = factor(model, rev(names(model_colours))))]
panel_a <- ggplot(fc, aes(100 * d2, model, colour = model, shape = evidence)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = 100 * d2_low, xmax = 100 * d2_high), width = 0, linewidth = 0.45,
                orientation = "y", position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, fill = "white", position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  facet_grid(scheme ~ contrast, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 21), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Held-out deviance explained (%)", y = NULL,
       title = "A flexible climate model and species-specific evidence") +
  theme_figure() + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0))

sc[, `:=`(pair = factor(pair, rev(unique(pair))),
          evidence = factor(c(all = "All classified", specific = "Species-specific")[evidence]))]
panel_b <- ggplot(sc, aes(100 * difference, pair, shape = evidence)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = 100 * difference_low, xmax = 100 * difference_high), width = 0,
                linewidth = 0.45, orientation = "y", position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                colour = "#E69F00") +
  geom_point(size = 2, fill = "white", colour = "#E69F00", position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 21), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Difference in obligate share within shared climates (points)", y = NULL,
       title = "Shared climates, species-specific evidence") +
  theme_figure()

dm <- dr[contrast == "mutualist"]
dm[, label := paste(c(dry_months = "Dry months", deficit_months = "Water-deficit months")[property],
                    "-", analysis)]
lg <- logo[analysis == "Given region and lineage", .(low = min(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                     high = max(estimate, na.rm = TRUE))]
panel_c <- ggplot(dm, aes(estimate, label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = lg$low, xmax = lg$high, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey88") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = estimate - 1.96 * se, xmax = estimate + 1.96 * se), width = 0,
                linewidth = 0.5, orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = p < 0.05), shape = 21, size = 2.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "white"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Effect on obligate mutualism (log odds per SD)", y = NULL,
       title = "Dry seasons and obligate mutualism",
       subtitle = "Grey: range of the estimate when each genus is left out") +
  theme_figure()

gb[, genus := factor(genus, genus[order(difference)])]
panel_d <- ggplot(gb, aes(difference, genus)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = difference, yend = genus), colour = "grey55") +
  geom_point(aes(size = mutualists), colour = "#E69F00") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 4, name = "Obligate mutualists") +
  labs(x = "Dry months, obligate mutualists minus facultative (SD)", y = NULL,
       title = "Each mixed genus weighted equally") +
  theme_figure() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))

fig <- panel_a / (panel_b | panel_c) / panel_d + plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")")
save_figure(fig, "plot_robustness", 10, 12)
fig
```

```{r clear_plot_robustness, include=FALSE}
invisible(gc())
```
